text:
Mara: quick q — for /v1/generate, what's our canonical behavior when optional object fields (e.g. `metadata`) are not present? send `metadata: null` or omit the key? some clients parse null differently.
Josh: omit. null is ambiguous for typed clients.
Tina: FYI our current AJV schema allows null because we used `nullable: true` on some fields — tests passed because validator accepts null.
Mara: that's the exact mismatch. we need a decision to avoid downstream parsing bugs. breaking change ok?
Linus: try not to break. option: normalize at the runtime edge — coerce `null` -> remove key for objects/arrays, and keep the schema non-nullable.
Chandra: agree with normalization. also define policy: if semantics mean "empty container" return `[]` or `{}`, otherwise omit the key.
Mara: concrete actions: (1) runtime normalizer that strips nulls for container-typed fields, (2) update JSON schema to disallow nullable for containers, (3) add a warning log when we coerce null -> absent. Tina can add tests? @Tina
Tina: yep. I'll add unit tests for `stripNullContainers()` + e2e that hits the validator. will also add a test for streaming ndjson parsing.
Josh: Content-Type question: do we require `application/json` or prefer vendor type `application/vnd.redwood+json`?
Linus: gateway accepts both today. Suggest docs show vendor type, but runtime validator accept either for backward compatibility. emit a metric when vendor type is missing.
Mara: sounds good. PR should mention acceptance policy and metric.
Tina: small snippet I'll add to runtime:
```
function stripNullContainers(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
  return Object.entries(obj).reduce((acc, [k, v]) => {
    if (v === null) return acc; // drop null containers
    if (Array.isArray(v)) acc[k] = v.map(stripNullContainers);
    else if (typeof v === 'object') acc[k] = stripNullContainers(v);
    else acc[k] = v;
    return acc;
  }, {});
}
```
Josh: nice. tiny comment: prefer pure return (don't mutate). left a nit on the PR.
Chandra: also add a flag to toggle strict mode (fail on nulls) for enterprise/private deployments.
Mara: good call — make the normalizer configurable per deployment.
Deploy-bot: mara pushed branch `fix/null-normalize` — CI started :circleci:
Josh: reviewing now, tests look good so far.
Tina: added e2e coverage for streaming responses with missing keys (ndjson consumers should parse fine when keys are absent).
Chandra: left one comment about performance of deep traversal on large payloads. Lina suggested shallow pass for known schema fields.
Mara: we'll limit normalization to schema-declared container fields to avoid full deep walk. add that to PR description.
Josh: approved after nit, merging once CI green. :white_check_mark:
Mara: thanks all — canarying in staging for 24h, I'll watch for null-coercion warnings. cc @Linus
Linus: I'll add an alert for >50 warnings/hour and a dashboard panel for normalized-field counts.
Mara: resolved for now, reopen if we see client parsing regressions.
